parts.text: We are seeking to hire PhD students (staring in Fall 2026) and Postdocs (starting in July 2026) in accessibility, human-computer interaction, human-robot interaction, multimodal systems in the School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence (SCAI) at Arizona State University (ASU). You can see example projects at

Desirable qualifications:

• Degree in computer Science, computer engineering, or related fields.
• Knowledge or skills in one of the above mentioned areas.
• Strong programming skills.
• Proficiency in English, both in speaking and writing.
• Publications in top venues (e.g., CHI, UIST, ASSETS, HRI).

ASU School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence (SCAI) is consistently ranked among the top 40 in the world in robotics, HCI, and visualization. We are located at the beautiful Tempe campus, part of the Phoenix metropolitan area, the nation's fifth largest city.
